root: ^What are you looking at? I am working to find out whoever did this.

s: ^Since you are security, shouldn’t you have a weapon on you?
^What is the security like in this place?

c-0: ^Yes. In the event of a catastrophic emergency, we have to have firearms at the ready. Once the lights went out, I must have dropped it or lost it during all the chaos…
c-1: ^Dominic was indebted to the… organization I was with. Management if you will. In addition to the loan he received for the play, he was offered first class security as part of his deal. As you know, all guests have to go through a metal detector and a pat down before entering the premises. The exception however is VIP guests, since they are personally vetted by staff. One of the perks of being of money I suppose.
c-2: ^My position was backstage for the last scene of the play. Right before the lights went out, I noticed some strange looking papers in one of the tables in the left corner. Right after, I thought I smelled something metallic, right near the service exit. Could be steel, could be blood. I have a good nose for these things.
c-3: ^Move along, wait until the authorities come.
